title: YouTube Synthesizer
summary: Turn one YouTube transcript into three evidence-backed hooks and one complete long-form Threads draft using twelve immutable, source-gated templates.
triggers: turn this YouTube video into a Threads thread
synthesize this video in my voice

inputs.name: one YouTube URL or pasted TXT, VTT, or SRT transcript plus Brain context or three approved voice samples

outputs.name: all twelve template scores, three evidence-backed hooks, one eligible long-form thread or an abstention, and a body-free receipt

free_capabilities: no-key public YouTube caption extraction through the pinned youtube-transcript package
optional installed yt-dlp caption-only fallback with media download disabled
local TXT, VTT, and SRT transcript parsing
deterministic scoring of all twelve immutable templates
evidence-gated three-hook and long-form thread drafting with abstention
immutable local delivery approval packets and private manual fallback
paid_capability_stubs: connected Threadify Brain reads depend on current account scopes and entitlement; three approved local writing samples are the complete fallback
connected Threads validation, media upload, scheduling, publish-now, and authoritative readback depend on current Threadify capabilities

must_show: source video identity, transcript route, language, and coverage
voice route and approved samples or Brain read boundary
all twelve scores and eligibility reasons
three exact hook drafts and their evidence references
complete selected thread, evidence map, warnings, and abstention state
for optional delivery: exact account, ordered thread, action, time and timezone, image hash and provider reference, visible automation state, and stable idempotency key

instructions: If public captions fail, try an installed yt-dlp only with --skip-download and subtitle flags; never fetch video or audio.
If caption tools remain unavailable, request pasted TXT, VTT, or SRT and preserve the route in the receipt.
If Threadify Brain is unavailable, require at least three creator-approved writing samples before drafting.
If no template satisfies every evidence requirement, return three hooks only when individually supported and abstain from the full thread.
Return a private local draft without saving, scheduling, publishing, or predicting performance.
If delivery tools are unavailable, return the exact private manual handoff; never claim an upload, schedule, or publication.

must_prove: source video ID and transcript route
